title: Model U v1 base, US100 CFD, frozen forward-only test
status_at_registration: OPEN - NEEDS MORE DATA, frozen forward-only test
registered_at: 2026-10-04 (SAST); this file's git commit on main is the registration timestamp, not any script-written field
rule_object_root: /workspace/ict-blueprint (not a git repo; files pinned by sha256)
decision_series: US100 only (CAPITALCOM:US100), first trade per day (variant v1); v1_reentry rows never count
disclosure_series: US500 (CAPITALCOM:US500) logged and reported separately; never pooled, never gating

forward_feed.note: Forward feed is TradingView CAPITALCOM, NOT Dukascopy. Rows from PEPPERSTONE/OANDA/Yahoo fallbacks are logged but never counted.

counting_rules.first_eligible_session: first NY session that starts after BOTH this file and the patched forward-harness sha256 (harness_sha256 below) are committed on main; earliest possible 2026-10-05
counting_rules.pre_registration_rows_excluded: every row dated before first_eligible_session, incl. 2026-09-28..2026-10-02
counting_rules.live_alerted_only: a row counts only if the harness logged the fill alert live, before the trade's exit time; backfilled rows are logged (note=BACKFILLED) and reported separately, never counted
counting_rules.raw_bars_required: every session (live or backfill) must persist the raw 1m bars it consumed to raw/forward/<inst>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv with sha256 in the log row; a row without raw bars does not count
counting_rules.holiday_filter: exclude NYSE full closures and NYSE early-close days (see holidays below); 2025-12-24 added to the historical exclusion list
counting_rules.min_bar_filter: session counts only if >= 285 of 300 1m bars present in 07:00-11:59 NY on the forward feed; ex-gap-day (any missing bar 07:00-11:59) results co-reported
counting_rules.timezone: all rule times America/New_York wall clock

holidays_excluded.maintenance: ORION-compiled from NYSE rules; DATA to verify against the published NYSE calendar and extend for each new year before that year's first session

binding_pass_at_N_550: one-sided 95% lower bound > 0 (percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261004)
random-entry foil F1 (random minute 09:00-10:59, random side, same day/risk/targets/costs, exit by 11:29 close; research/scripts/post_wave1/h013_foil_rebuild.py method) >= 95th percentile
mean with top 1% of trades by R dropped > 0
mean with small-stop trades (risk_pts < sample p25) excluded > 0
US500 cross-market failure disclosed in any result prose
binding_fail: at N=550, failing any pass criterion = FAILS. CASSANDRA ruled no interim kill; none is binding.
non_binding_orion_gates: max DD (R) <= bootstrap p95 at realized N (100: 25.1R, 250: 35.7R, 550: 43.7R) and longest losing streak <= p99 (100: 16, 250: 19, 550: 21)
futility read at N>=100: one-sided 97.5% upper bound < +0.15 -> recommend FAILS to CASSANDRA
Holm alpha split across H013+H014 (one-sided 0.025, N 720) reported alongside
required_co_reports: stream label FWD-TV-CAPITALCOM-US100 on every forward result; DUKASCOPY-CFD-USATECHIDXUSD-BID1M on every historical citation
CAPITALCOM measured spread and price side (bid vs mid) before any forward R is read
1-pt trade-through on entries and stops; R capped at +5; long/short split

harness_sha256.status: REGISTERED when this file lands on origin/main (the harness checks origin/main at run time and records the landing commit time); before that, rows are logged but never counted
harness_sha256.replaces: PENDING - patched forward harness (FILL_THRU=1, CAPITALCOM only, holiday + min-bar filters, raw-bar persistence, docs corrected) must be hashed and committed here before first_eligible_session

changes_after_registration: any change to a pinned hash, feed, window, exit or filter voids counting from that point and requires a new ID (H013b)
